sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', d.date)::date AS ds, SUM(d.total_passengers) AS y FROM daily_passenger_stats d WHERE d.route_id = '85' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'HTX-195' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('quarter', d.date) ORDER BY ds ASC
sql_explanation: Retrieves the sum of total passengers (y) for route 85 operated by HTX-195, aggregated by quarter (ds).
